name: Tourmatez
summary: Bengali-language social media posters for a travel planning app, designed in Figma.
identity: Green, yellow and white with travel destination photography, Bengali headline typography and app-focused, mobile-first compositions.
contribution: Social media poster design in Figma. App screens that appear inside the posters belong to the Tourmatez product; my role was designing the posters.

categoryNotes.single-posts: Travel inspiration, group trip planning, travel partner recruitment and app awareness posters.
categoryNotes.carousels: Multi-slide Tourmatez stories — added here as they are published.
categoryNotes.videos: Promotional videos and reels for Tourmatez.
categoryNotes.campaigns: App marketing campaigns, travel promotions and partner recruitment campaigns.
